subject: Add root-level turbo test script that runs all package tests in parallel
description: Add a `test` pipeline to turbo.json and a `pnpm test` root script that runs tests across all packages in parallel. Must handle packages without tests gracefully (signer has a stale jest script with no test files). Ensure it works without database connection issues — may need to mock or skip DB-dependent tests in CI-like runs.
activeForm: Setting up root-level turbo test pipeline
